title: Art Machine
description: Panoramic mixed-media collage assembles mechanical and electronic components — reel-to-reel deck elements, knobs, circuit-board fragments — into a frontal robot-like face. Two large gold concentric rings with orange spray halos dominate the center, flanked by printed cardboard strips, ink marks, and a bold fabric-letter word 'Art' at lower right.
composition: bilateral symmetry around central mechanical face
